info.title: Real World API
info.description: Fork today's simulated world, read its agents, answer the daily question and check the hashed receipts. Every fork result is labelled simulated.

post.summary: Start a fork: add one event to today's world and run it forward. Returns an id.

parameters.name: Authorization

schema.description: Bearer rw_... API key. Without one the caller is anonymous and max_cost_usd is clamped.

parameters.description: Bearer rw_... API key. Without one the caller is anonymous and max_cost_usd is clamped.

401.description: The API key is unknown or revoked

402.description: The estimate exceeds max_cost_usd, the key's cap or today's fork budget is spent

409.description: This Idempotency-Key is running a fork, or was used with another body

422.description: The request is invalid, Real-World-Version is not the current version, or the event breaks the acceptable-use policy

429.description: This address has used today's anonymous forks

503.description: A spend, address or acceptable-use check could not run; nothing was started

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: Change in the agent's belief, in logit.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Who wrote the text: "anthropic", or "fake" (no model ran).

estimated_usd.title: Estimated Usd
estimated_usd.description: An estimate made before the run, at the configured model's prices.

actual_usd.title: Actual Usd
actual_usd.description: Dollars the provider charged; 0 with the fake model.

mean.title: Mean
mean.description: Mean of other visitors' answers; null if there are none.

count.title: Count
count.description: Other visitors' answers; the caller's own is never counted.

question.description: The forecast's question from its committed question set; null on other leaves.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One sentence saying what was refused and why, for display.

id.title: Id
id.description: The fork already running under this Idempotency-Key.

week.title: Week
week.description: The seven days ending today, oldest first.

world.title: World
world.description: The snapshot to fork: today's world, or a committed day as YYYY-MM-DD.

event.description: The one event to add, in plain words.

days.title: Days
days.description: Simulated days to run after the event.

members.title: Members
members.description: Ensemble members: independent runs of the fork, each with its own agent subsample and noise. Their p10-p90 range is the spread.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Agents sampled from the world snapshot, in proportion to country population.

topics.title: Topics
topics.description: Topics to report; null means every topic the world tracks.

max_cost_usd.title: Max Cost Usd
max_cost_usd.description: Cost cap in dollars. A fork whose estimate is above it is refused with 402. The estimate counts one model call per segment.

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: Fixes the agent subsample and each member's noise. The model's answers can still differ between runs.

disclosure.title: Disclosure
disclosure.default: AI-simulated. Not a poll or a prediction of a real person

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Who answered the model calls: "anthropic", or "fake" when no model ran.

top_shifts.title: Top Shifts
top_shifts.description: The largest median shifts among segments of at least top_shift_min_agents.

probability.title: Probability
probability.description: The visitor's answer that day; null if none.

brier.title: Brier
brier.description: Its Brier score once the question resolved.
